```python
import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.iterators import FrameIterator

# Reference the existing table
videos = pxt.get_table("videos")

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame,
# sampled at 1 frame per second
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    "videos_frames",
    videos,
    iterator=FrameIterator.create(video=videos.video, fps=1),
)
```
